tools.name: get_shared_transcript
tools.description: Fetch the full text of a transcript that someone has shared publicly from RiverScript, given its share link. Use this when the user pastes a riverscript.com/share/... link, or asks about the contents of one, so you can answer questions about the recording, summarise it, pull quotes, or translate it.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_shared_transcript · Private data: get_shared_transcript · Public sink: get_shared_transcript.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_shared_transcript · Private data: get_shared_transcript · Public sink: get_shared_transcript

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
